target_customer: API-first and infrastructure software companies whose sales teams need to demo complex products
problem: Demoing API and infrastructure products to buyers is hard because there is no visible interface, so sales teams struggle to show value.
product_category: Sales demo platform for API and technical products

founders.name: Spencer Levitt
founders.background_notes: Met Pager as a classmate at Northwestern where they built apps on APIs, per TechCrunch.

competitors.name: Demostack
competitors.funding_then: 34M dollars raised as of the 2023 article, not as of 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating live interactive UIs from API sandboxes and docs is non-trivial but achievable for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Demo content built on the platform adds some lock-in, but rival demo vendors and in-house tools are alternatives.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; rivals targeted general product demos rather than API demos.

market_need_then: API-first companies lacked a visual way to demo; evidence is the 2023 TechCrunch framing. No 2021 demand data found.

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press covered the seed round, but the common name is shared with many brands, including a fleet card company, and no brand-specific coverage was found.

pivots.to: AI-era demo operations for technical products
pivots.why: Tagline changed per YC directory; reason not stated

outcome_analysis: Coast is active in New York with a team of 35 per YC. It raised a 2.1M dollar seed in April 2023, nearly two years after the batch, from YC and angels including Dropbox and Segment cofounders. No later verified round was found, and its positioning moved from API demos to AI-era demo operations without a stated reason.
notes: Company site trycoast.com could not be fetched because the domain safety check was rate limited. Aggregators (Seedtable, Zero G Talent) show a 40M Series B in 2024-07 led by ICONIQ, but that matches the unrelated fleet-card company Coast (coastpay.com, founder Daniel Simon), so it is excluded as a likely mix-up. Founded year conflicts: YC says 2022, CB Insights 2021. The competitor dates are 2023 and as-of-founding traction is unknown; no Launch HN found. The pivot row reflects the directory tagline only.
